mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS account_id, a.password_hash, a.session_generation, a.status AS account_status, COALESCE(ls.failed_attempts, 0) AS failed_attempts, ls.locked_until, mf.id AS mfa_factor_id, mf.encrypted_secret FROM account a LEFT JOIN account_login_security ls ON ls.account_id = a.id LEFT JOIN mfa_factor mf ON mf.account_id = a.id AND mf.factor_type = 'TOTP' AND mf.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE lower(a.login_name) = #{login} OR lower(a.email) = #{login} LIMIT 1

SELECT a.id AS account_id, a.password_hash, a.session_generation, a.status AS account_status, COALESCE(ls.failed_attempts, 0) AS failed_attempts, ls.locked_until, mf.id AS mfa_factor_id, mf.encrypted_secret FROM account a LEFT JOIN account_login_security ls ON ls.account_id = a.id LEFT JOIN mfa_factor mf ON mf.account_id = a.id AND mf.factor_type = 'TOTP' AND mf.status = 'ACTIVE' AND mf.encrypted_secret IS NOT NULL WHERE a.id = #{accountId}

SELECT CASE WHEN bool_or(r.role_type = 'ORGANIZATION_ADMIN') THEN 'ORGANIZATION_ADMIN' ELSE 'OPERATOR' END AS principal_type, state.authorization_generation FROM account_tenant_security_state state JOIN account_membership membership ON membership.tenant_id = state.tenant_id AND membership.account_id = state.account_id AND membership.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN membership_role mr ON mr.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND mr.membership_id = membership.id LEFT JOIN role r ON r.id = mr.role_id AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE state.account_id = #{accountId} AND state.tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY state.authorization_generation

SELECT 'PLATFORM_ADMIN' AS principal_type, a.authorization_generation FROM account a WHERE a.id = #{accountId} AND a.status = 'ACTIVE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM account_platform_role apr JOIN role r ON r.id = apr.role_id WHERE apr.account_id = a.id AND r.tenant_id IS NULL AND r.role_type = 'PLATFORM_ADMIN' AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' )
SELECT code FROM permission ORDER BY code

SELECT DISTINCT p.code FROM permission p WHERE p.tenant_assignable AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM account_membership membership JOIN membership_role mr ON mr.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND mr.membership_id = membership.id JOIN role r ON r.id = mr.role_id AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE membership.account_id = #{accountId} AND membership.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND membership.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.role_type = 'ORGANIZATION_ADMIN' ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM account_membership membership JOIN membership_role mr ON mr.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND mr.membership_id = membership.id JOIN role r ON r.id = mr.role_id AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id WHERE membership.account_id = #{accountId} AND membership.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND membership.status = 'ACTIVE' AND rp.permission_id = p.id )) ORDER BY p.code

SELECT DISTINCT organization.path FROM account_membership membership JOIN organization ON organization.id = membership.organization_id AND organization.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id JOIN membership_role mr ON mr.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND mr.membership_id = membership.id JOIN role ON role.id = mr.role_id AND role.status = 'ACTIVE' AND role.role_type = 'ORGANIZATION_ADMIN' WHERE membership.account_id = #{accountId} AND membership.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND membership.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY organization.path

SELECT DISTINCT organization.path AS organization_path, permission.code AS permission_code FROM account_membership membership JOIN organization ON organization.id = membership.organization_id AND organization.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id JOIN membership_role mr ON mr.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND mr.membership_id = membership.id JOIN role ON role.id = mr.role_id AND role.status = 'ACTIVE' AND role.role_type = 'OPERATOR' JOIN role_permission assignment ON assignment.role_id = role.id JOIN permission ON permission.id = assignment.permission_id AND permission.tenant_assignable WHERE membership.account_id = #{accountId} AND membership.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND membership.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY organization.path, permission.code

SELECT DISTINCT grant.resource_type, grant.resource_id, grant.action FROM resource_grant grant JOIN account_membership membership ON membership.id = grant.membership_id AND membership.tenant_id = grant.tenant_id WHERE membership.account_id = #{accountId} AND membership.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND membership.status = 'ACTIVE' AND grant.effect = 'ALLOW' AND grant.revoked_at IS NULL AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM membership_role mr JOIN role ON role.id = mr.role_id AND role.status = 'ACTIVE' AND role.role_type = 'ORGANIZATION_ADMIN' WHERE mr.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND mr.membership_id = membership.id ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM membership_role mr JOIN role ON role.id = mr.role_id AND role.status = 'ACTIVE' AND role.role_type = 'OPERATOR' JOIN role_permission assignment ON assignment.role_id = role.id JOIN permission ON permission.id = assignment.permission_id AND permission.tenant_assignable WHERE mr.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND mr.membership_id = membership.id AND permission.code = grant.resource_type || ':' || lower(grant.action) ) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_login_security(account_id, failed_attempts, locked_until, last_failed_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{accountId}, 1, #{lockedUntil}, #{now}, #{now}) ON CONFLICT (account_id) DO UPDATE SET failed_attempts = account_login_security.failed_attempts + 1, locked_until = #{lockedUntil}, last_failed_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}
